claims.statement: Quickstart describes collaborative nontracked conversation and public forum, yet supports private/internal repositories with inherited visibility; public wording does not authorize disclosure or require public access.

Repository owners/write users can enable discussions under guide prose; setup edits welcome template and starts discussion. Feature activation is a write requiring actual target authority, not performed here.

Organization owners enable discussions, select source repository and Save, with cloud/GHES settings navigation differences; existing or purpose-specific source is choice, not mandate to create/restructure unrelated repos.
Organization discussions appear on organization and source repository pages; participation/management inherits source permissions, not duplicated independent content or universal member authority.
Source repository can change but existing discussions are not transferred; ownership pointer change is not data migration, preservation or rollback verification.
Welcome/pin/lock, CONTRIBUTING/project README and organization profile README are optional communication recommendations; file existence does not prove healthy conduct or enforced moderation.

Broad any-authenticated-viewer creation/poll prose remains subject to configured creation permissions, announcement restrictions and GHEC managed-user limits in detailed guides; source mismatch retained.
Shared creation procedure uses category/title/body and Start; poll title/question/at least two options differs format fragments omitting polls. No poll-integrity proof or mandatory participation.

Write category/deletion/pin/transfer prose and triage moderation prose coexist with versioned management and maintain/admin category fragments; preserve per-operation role conflicts rather than assign one blanket privilege.
Recategorization and shared label statements do not override poll move prohibition or cloud-qualified detailed discussion label support; source scope conflicts remain.

Issue creation after scoped concept maturity is recommendation; Next steps points to moderation/conversion page, not exact issue-creation procedure. Retain link mismatch rather than infer operation equivalence.
